name: Gravel
desc: A crushed-stone gravel plane running away to the vanishing point — loose angular pebbles packed at random, each a little mound whose crown flares as a raking light pool drifts over it while its neighbour drops into grit-shadow, dust blowing low across the bed; dry granite chippings, rain-wet, a sepia plate, black volcanic ash, or a cyan survey plan.

energy.doc: how hard the light pools rake the stone — crown flare, grit contrast, scroll rate

scale.doc: stone size in world units — min a fine grit of tiny chippings, max coarse cobbly rubble

density.doc: how much dust drifts low across the bed

speed.doc: how fast the gravel bed streams toward the viewer

wear.doc: how loose and open the pack is — grit-gap width and shadow between stones

x.doc: vanishing point x as a canvas fraction

y.doc: horizon y as a canvas fraction — everything above stays fully transparent so the bg shows through

style.doc: aesthetic: dry grey granite chippings under a raking light / rain-wet with sheen standing in the hollows / a warm sepia plate / black volcanic ash and cinder / a cyan survey plan, the stone cells as pure line

seed.doc: stone lottery — per-pebble tone, grain and the scatter of the pack
